# §2 · #2 — Sym-Ballein

<!-- reader-navigation -->
Movement 21 of 48 · [This room](../ROOM.md) · [← Previous](20-s2-p1-dia-ballein.md) · [Next →](22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia.md)
<!-- /reader-navigation -->

## Movement thesis

[[section-rooms/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn|Sym-Ballein]] writes superpositional polarity as inverse orientations of the retained ground–mark relation:

$$
\operatorname{sym\text{-}ballein}:\frac{(0/1)}{(1/0)}.
$$

Each inner slash holds the indefinite and definite together. The outer slash relates their conjugate orientations. \(0/1\) is ground becoming legible through a mark; \(1/0\) is the mark returning toward a ground it cannot convert into content.

Superposition belongs first to the dual-non-dual ontology. Ground and manifestation are real distinctions within one appearing-act, and each is present only through the relation that prevents it from becoming self-sufficient; separately complete substances would already presuppose the relation being derived. QL gives this co-presence a mathematical and symbolic articulation native to the claim. Quantum state space and non-classical logics enter later as formal neighbours whose similarities and differences can be stated after the ontology has established its own meaning.

## AND/OR logic

The slash operates as AND/OR. The terms are conjoined because neither exists as the present relation without the other. They are disjoined because ground is not mark and mark is not ground. Superposition therefore means simultaneous relational presence, not probabilistic blur or fusion.

At the inner level:

- \(0/1\): origin-to-expression, Power-to-Name, the field becoming a determination;
- \(1/0\): expression-to-origin, Name-to-Power, the determination becoming transparent to its field.

At the outer level, the two readings form one event and remain irreducibly inverse. The slash is the quotient in both senses: division discloses the relation, and quotienting constructs a new space by declared identifications.

## Symbolic force and fusion boundary

Sym-ballein is the root of symbolon: a token broken in two whose halves authenticate one another across separation, distance, and time. The symbolon is materially a trust-device. Its fracture verifies rather than destroys the bond. Wholeness is not pristine identity. It is fracture retained as relation.

Sym-ballein-mode knowledge offers provisional anchors. Embodied competence, relationship, lineage, land, ritual, family, source, and institution can distribute the conditions in which uncertainty is borne without a single object occupying the whole. [[section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit|Trust, Faith, and the Formal Limit]] names the living relation those anchors serve; [[section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many|Mono-Poly: Whole and Many]] names the social topology in which many anchors need not be absorbed by one false whole.

In technical systems the same principle becomes provenance, reversible traversal, visible alternatives, inspectable seams, and plural governance. A decision can remain decisive while carrying where it came from.

Sym-ballein is therefore the compositional half of [[section-rooms/arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology|the runtime]]. It preserves dia-ballein's branch while making that branch carry the problem it answered, the alternatives it excluded, the counter-reading that can contest it, and the wider state it changes. The result is an epistemic object whose relation to its own conditions remains executable; a metadata log records the trail but cannot by itself perform the return.

Its danger is fusion: the fantasy that shared ground abolishes different positions or dissolves power. Sym-ballein remains healthy only when the seam stays visible.

A guard belongs beside the form itself: sym-ballein is not "the whole." It is the logic of defining towards wholeness — the accounting in which a determination retains ground, inverse, and relations through which it can complete as `0/1 → 4+2` and release. A claim to have achieved the whole would already be a `1` occupying the zero; the retained seam is what keeps wholeness a direction of definition rather than a possession. The Greek register holds this natively in adjacent fragments of Heraclitus: B51's backwards-turning fastening gives retained tension its instrument in bow and lyre, and B50 — in Heidegger's rendering of *legein* as "the Laying that gathers" (*die lesende Lege*, *Early Greek Thinking*, p. 66) — gives Logos itself the shape of a gathering that lets what it gathers lie together before us without consuming it. One movement ahead waits the gathering's counterfeit: the net that gathers to arrest.

## Divining the third: divine and concur

Sym-ballein does not insert a third party at the centre of an already-given left/right spectrum. It divines the third: the transcendental relation that makes the spectrum, its institutions, and its antagonisms possible in the first place. `0/1` is the common ground taking determinate form; `1/0` is the formed determination returning to the ground—people, labour, memory, material conditions, and exclusions—that it cannot own. The third is therefore not neutral. It does not deny empire/subject, institution/citizen, or rich/poor; it makes their unequal co-production visible, and reveals where authority has detached itself from the conditions it governs.

“Divine and concur” names this method. To divine is to find, in the apparent self-sufficiency of a pole, the relation it has obscured or appropriated. To concur is not to agree, fuse, or settle at the midpoint; it is for differentiated positions to move together through the ground none possesses. The unitive praxis is the continual reorientation of `(+1)/(−1)` through `(0/1)/(1/0)`: opposition remains articulate, while each pole becomes answerable to the relation it neither created nor can exhaust.

The political difference is exact. Divide and conquer makes the wound in relation governable: atomise persons, bind them to a target, and offer the apparatus as their only shared subject. Divine and concur reverses the direction. It returns the apparent subject—State, Party, market, institution, empire—to the determinate relations from which it draws force and legitimacy. It asks whose labour sustains the form, whose exclusion secures it, [which office authorises it](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/technology-politics/DEVELOPMENT.md#formation-and-enframing), which record makes it claimable, and by what path the governed may contest and alter it. This is not a view from nowhere and not a reconciliation that absolves power. It is the practical condition in which a collective need not become a mass in order to act together: reciprocal contestability, provenance, and return.

[Homologia / Analogia](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#operations) **qualifies** gathering through what it preserves: both determinate orientations, their inverse relation and the conditions under which their result can be contested. This is why concurrence does not require one interchangeable voice. The achieved agreement must still let the participants differ and let their difference change the common undertaking. Greek agreement, the historical token and the native slash each retain their own warrant; neither lexical kinship nor an agreed outcome performs the source-return on its own.

## Transition

The retained branch **returns-to** [Count-to-Account](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#count-to-account) when its source, exclusion and consequence remain available for the next act of gathering. The combine-phase must allow those relations to alter coordination. A count can therefore remain decisive within the account, while participants retain different positions and the power to contest how their contributions are composed.

The mytheme of war, love, craft, and concord shows what these two logics feel like when embodied: [[22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia|§2 · #3 — Ares, Aphrodite, and Harmonia]].

The [Symbol / Account / Trust whole-field — Symbol answers to source](../../../symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#symbol-answers-to-source) **qualifies** this operation at evidence register 3. The matching seam keeps an achieved sign answerable across separation, and provisional anchors remain able to receive a changed encounter. The resulting distinction **returns-to** that whole field with the consumer’s own source and evidential limits retained.

Shared meaning retains the participants’ differences; a token’s matching seam does not eliminate power or guarantee trust; the [language history](../../../symbolon/episteme/histories/traditions-and-disciplines/language-symbol-dialogue/DEVELOPMENT.md#language-dialogue) **qualifies** this operational comparison.

The [authored P1 route for M21](../P1-CANONICAL-ALIGNMENT.md#p1-m21) **grounds** this movement’s canonical A/C alignment within the phase bounds and dispositions stated there.
